record.what_it_does: Waterfall enriches and searches B2B contacts and companies via a waterfall of data providers.
record.auth_notes: API key in the x-api-key header to https://api.waterfall.io. There is no OAuth. Keys can be managed through an API Keys endpoint.
record.access_notes: The docs' 'Get API access' page says the team reviews every access request. Pricing is credit-based and quoted after a benchmark, with no public plans. I saw no mention of free credits or a free trial.
record.api_breadth_notes: 13 APIs. Async: Prospector, Contact Enrichment, Phone Enrichment, Company Enrichment. Sync: Search Contact, Search Company, Company Reveal, Company Titles, Job Change, Email Verification, Webhook JWKS, Account Reporting, API Key Management.
record.mcp_notes: No MCP is mentioned in the docs index or on the pricing page. The docs have an 'agents' section that refers to 'official API skills'.
record.blocker_notes: Credentials need access approval and a paid or contract-based credit arrangement. Auth is per-customer API key, so end users must bring their own key.

evidence.quote: Send your API key in the `x-api-key` header to `https://api.waterfall.io`.
Pay for answers, not for lookups

record.needs_human: Check the 'Get API access' page for the approval process and any trial credits. The access-review finding comes from a summary of that page, which I did not open directly. Quotes are paraphrased from fetch summaries, not verbatim page text.
